transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Nice to meet you too. Um, well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is that my eating has just been completely all over the place lately. Like, some weeks I barely even touch my dinner. But then other nights, I’ll just be standing there in the dark in the kitchen, eating crackers and sweets after everyone’s gone to bed. 

I usually get those little buttery crackers... you know the ones? I used to eat them all the time back when I was taking some college classes. There was this little corner store right off campus that sold them, and the owner had this huge orange cat that would just sit on the counter by the register. It would just stare at you while you were trying to count your change. I always wondered what happened to that cat. I really love cats, but we can't have them where I live now. 

But, um... yeah, so my eating is just really erratic right now.
When those nights happen, do you feel like you eat an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time?

Um, I wouldn't say it's a huge amount, no. Just a normal amount of crackers and sweets, I think. But it's just so quiet in the house then, you know? You can hear the refrigerator humming. Ours makes this weird clicking noise every time the ice maker kicks on. We had a repairman look at it last month, this nice younger guy who said it was just a loose valve or something. He actually went to the same high school as my niece. Small world, right? She's studying to be a dental hygienist now, which is funny because she used to be completely terrified of the dentist when she was little. She would just scream the whole car ride there... wait, what was I saying? Did I answer your question?
After those nighttime eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?

No, no, I don't do that. I hate throwing up. I actually haven't thrown up since... oh, gosh, it must have been that bad stomach bug going around three years ago. Or maybe four? It was right around Thanksgiving because I remember we had to cancel our dinner plans. My sister had already bought this massive turkey, too. She ended up having to freeze half of it, and then she made turkey soup for like a month straight. She makes really good soup, though. She puts those little star-shaped noodles in it. I always try to find those at the grocery store, but they only ever have the regular alphabet ones. The alphabet ones are okay, but they get mushy too fast. Do you like soup? Wait, sorry. No, I don't make myself throw up.
Have you lost enough weight that you’re now significantly underweight for your height?

No, I haven't really lost weight like that. I'm definitely not underweight. My clothes still fit exactly the same. I actually just bought a new pair of jeans last week because they were on clearance at the mall. The mall is just so empty lately, it's actually kind of sad to walk through. Half the stores are just boarded up now. There used to be this amazing pretzel stand right by the center fountain that made these really warm cinnamon sugar ones... my husband and I would get them every single time we went Christmas shopping. He absolutely hates shopping, but he'd put up with it just for those pretzels. Now he just buys everything online. We get brown boxes on our porch almost every day. Our delivery guy must hate us because our front steps are so steep. We've been meaning to fix the railing on those steps before it snows, but... um. Wait, did you ask about my clothes? No, my weight. Right. Yeah, I haven't lost much weight at all.
When you eat during the night, are you fully awake?

Um, yeah, I'm awake. I mean, I have to actually get up and walk to the kitchen, so I'm definitely awake. I usually turn on the little light over the stove so I don't trip over the cat. He loves sleeping right in the middle of the hallway, right where you can't see him in the dark. We got him from a shelter about five years ago, and they told us he was a Maine Coon mix, but honestly, he just looks like a regular orange tabby to me. He is huge, though. He eats constantly. We have to buy this special food for him because his stomach is sensitive, and it costs a fortune. It comes in these little pouches that are impossible to open without getting gravy all over your fingers. I hate the smell of it, especially at night when the house is all closed up. The smell just lingers. Wait, what did you ask me? Was it about being awake? Yeah, I'm awake when I get up.
When you eat at night, do you wake up from sleep before you go to the kitchen?

Well, yeah, I do wake up from sleep first. But honestly, that's what finally pushed me to come in, because my eating has just been all over the place lately. Some weeks I barely touch dinner at all, and then other nights I'll just stand in the kitchen eating crackers and sweets after everyone else has gone to bed. We have these buttery crackers that my husband likes, the kind that come in the little green box? He always buys them in bulk at that warehouse club down the highway. I don't know why we need a membership there, honestly. We end up buying way more than we actually need just because it's cheap. Like last time, he bought a three-pack of mayonnaise, and it expired before we even opened the second jar. I told him we should just stick to the regular grocery store, but he loves the free samples they give out on the weekends. They had these little pizza bagel bites last time that were actually pretty good, though they burnt the roof of my mouth. I hate when that happens, it feels weird for days. Wait, what were we talking about? Oh, right, waking up. Yeah, I wake up first, and then I end up eating all those snacks.
